Conflicting ranks despite equal aggregate scores remain unavailable; no selection of favorable attempts.
Original reference metrics and all5 replay completions gate expanded reporting.
Late additions or removal of per-attempt artifacts/terminal markers invalidate the observation; the attempted snapshot cannot silently ignore a new conflicting FAILED marker.
Pre-existing COMPLETE.json.partial or FAILED.json.partial also blocks eligibility and cannot authorize a retry.
Empty or malformed split/rank tensors remain unavailable without aborting the entire attempt-history summary; corrupt bytes and reported metrics are retained.

limits: Artificial fixtures establish bounded reporting behavior, not experimental success.
This verifies saved-rank consistency and original ordering; it does not rescore fitted maps.
No tool can establish solely from a submitted directory that an external operator never moved or removed an attempt.
Recorded review statements do not independently prove the cause of failure.
Final outer release must bind this helper before inspecting real panel outcomes.
